reason: rule has no external semantics
verification: assert inputs outputs and boundary cases

reason: format and error cases are local; enumerable boundary behavior
verification: malformed and representative fixtures

when: large input domain or algebraic invariant
reason: examples alone leave broad cases; find counterexamples automatically
example: parser round trip or idempotent normalization
verification: seeded generators and minimal counterexample

reason: rendering plus local event ownership is the risk
anti_pattern: mock every child and assert calls
verification: assert role text state and user action

reason: accessible name role focus and error are behavior
example: keyboard form flow or custom control
verification: query by role or name and inspect focus

reason: validation auth mapping and persistence cross boundary
example: POST creates resource or returns typed error
anti_pattern: mock service and assert handler call
verification: real request plus response and durable effect

reason: transaction constraints isolation or query behavior matters
anti_pattern: in-memory object fake for DB semantics
verification: ephemeral DB or repository integration test

reason: invalidation freshness and key ownership matter
example: mutation then query returns fresh result
anti_pattern: clear cache in setup after every action
verification: assert targeted and unrelated keys

reason: independent producer and consumer must agree
anti_pattern: duplicated type assertion with no wire fixture
verification: consumer/provider contract check

reason: serialization and platform error mapping matter
verification: real bridge fixture or platform test

reason: system integration and navigation risk remains
verification: deterministic seed and user-visible assertions

reason: keyboard permissions lifecycle or deep links cross layers
verification: Detox synchronization and stable semantics

reason: reported invariant needs permanent proof
anti_pattern: write a broad E2E without reproducer
verification: red before fix and green after

reason: fix could be removed in future
verification: revert or disable fix and confirm red when practical

reason: dependency is not the semantics under test
example: clock provider or payment gateway boundary
verification: contract-shaped fake and one real integration path

reason: tests mutate global or module state
verification: restore in teardown and run repeatably

reason: passes alone but fails in suite
example: shared mutable fixture or leaked server
verification: repeat in random or parallel order without retry

reason: uses sleep or guessed timeout
verification: wait on state barrier or event with bounded timeout

reason: ordering and idempotency are the invariant
example: release two requests in controlled order
verification: barriers force both interleavings

reason: scale changes user experience
anti_pattern: assert duration on noisy shared host
verification: benchmark stable path and regression threshold

reason: large static structure is costly to assert manually
anti_pattern: snapshot is sole proof of behavior
verification: review diff and pair with semantic assertions
